instruction: The menu bar in Thunderbird is taking up valuable screen space. Can you help me configure it to auto-hide so it only appears when I press the Alt key?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling auto-hide for the menu bar in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks xulstore.json for toolbar-menubar.autohide set to 'true'. Verified that this setting exists in the sample xulstore.json. Similar complexity to original task.
metadata.verification: Verified xulstore.json contains 'toolbar-menubar' with 'autohide' attribute. The setting already exists in the profile and can be toggled through UI.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks Thunderbird's persistent configuration file (xulstore.json) where UI preferences are stored
JSON key path ['chrome://messenger/content/messenger.xhtml', 'toolbar-menubar', 'autohide'] correctly targets the menu bar auto-hide setting
Expected value 'true' (as string) is semantically correct for enabling auto-hide functionality
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird before file read, ensuring xulstore.json is flushed to disk (file is only written on app close)
The check_json metric function has robust error handling and correctly navigates nested JSON keys
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (enable auto-hide) and evaluator verifies exactly that requirement
Profile directory path matches the pre-configured profile from config setup, ensuring path stability

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
